eae2_pattern.workbench.group_hint: %s recipes. Click to expand; use the checkbox to select the group.
eae2_pattern.workbench.group_help: Same-output groups use the main output and its NBT. A recipe may appear in several tag groups, but shares one selection and is encoded once.
eae2_pattern.workbench.more_help: Selection, comparison, stored-pattern check and defaults.

eae2_pattern.workbench.preview_failed: Cannot encode. Check the source recipe.
eae2_pattern.workbench.server_preview_he: Multiplier, NBT and input filters are applied. Crafting previews show one valid input option; AE2 substitution settings control alternatives.
eae2_pattern.workbench.skip_no_guarantee: No outputs match the encoding settings
eae2_pattern.workbench.skip_no_input: No inputs remain after excluding reusable inputs
eae2_pattern.workbench.click_filter: Click to filter by this material and its NBT.
eae2_pattern.workbench.more_slots: %s more entries. Select the recipe to view them all.
eae2_pattern.workbench.row_help: Select a recipe for details, click an ingredient to filter, or check the box to encode it.

eae2_pattern.workbench.not_consumed: Not consumed · place in the machine

eae2_pattern.workbench.option_help: Click to choose. Use arrow keys to move, Enter to confirm and Esc to close.

eae2_pattern.report.no_blanks: Not enough blanks: %s needed, %s used. Encoding stopped.

eae2_pattern.report.too_many: Request limit exceeded (%s patterns). Select fewer recipes or check the server batch limits.

eae2_pattern.cmd.err.not_list: %s is not a list. Use set.

eae2_pattern.workbench.tools_help: When enabled, reusable inputs are omitted from processing patterns and must be placed in the machine. Disable to encode their original amounts. Other pattern types use the source recipe.
eae2_pattern.workbench.multiplier_help: Use ×2 to double or ÷2 to halve, from ×1 to ×%s. Only consumed inputs and outputs of processing patterns are scaled; reusable inputs stay unchanged.
eae2_pattern.workbench.multiplier_invali: Multiplier must be an integer from 1 to %s
eae2_pattern.workbench.wildcard_missing: Wildcard patterns are unavailable. Install EAE2 Pattern on both client and server.
eae2_pattern.workbench.wildcard_mode_hel: Collect recipes for one machine type in wildcard patterns, up to 2048 per pattern. Filter by form, material or search terms.
eae2_pattern.wildcard.name: Wildcard pattern · %s · %s recipes
eae2_pattern.wildcard.bound_help: Right-click to edit · up to 2048 recipes per pattern
eae2_pattern.wildcard.edit_help: Right-click to edit rules, or encode again from the machine recipe page.
eae2_pattern.workbench.skip_wildcard_pro: Wildcard patterns require registered processing recipes
eae2_pattern.editor.title: Wildcard encoding
eae2_pattern.editor.rule_help: Both sides must match. Exclusions skip the whole recipe; blank includes are unrestricted. Group matching allows terms on different ingredients; per-ingredient matching requires each to match. Search scope does not change encoded materials.
eae2_pattern.editor.syntax_help: @mod · $tag · &ID; names and #tooltips require fixed mode. Space=AND, |=OR, -=exclude; quotes and * ? supported.
eae2_pattern.editor.settings_help: Up to 2048 recipes per pattern. Fixed collections can split; narrow dynamic rules that exceed the limit. Multipliers do not scale reusable inputs; chance outputs may leave crafts waiting. New patterns are stored in the ME network.
eae2_pattern.editor.capacity_help: Up to 2048 recipes per pattern; fixed collections may split earlier. The exact blank count is checked before any are used.
eae2_pattern.editor.machine_search: Search machine name or type ID…
eae2_pattern.editor.legacy_help: Right-click to choose a machine and set encoding rules.
eae2_pattern.editor.policy_empty: No valid inputs or outputs remain. Adjust encoding settings.
eae2_pattern.editor.blank_help: Right-click to choose a machine and encode, without an ME connection. Place the encoded pattern in a provider connected to that machine.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_saved: Held pattern encoded. No extra blank patterns used.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_capacity_help: No ME connection or extra blanks needed. Stacked blanks need one empty inventory slot. Narrow the selection or save to the network if one pattern cannot hold it.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_settings_help: A single pattern is updated in place. From a blank stack, one result goes into your inventory. Changes to the held item or slot cancel the write; a full inventory uses no blanks. Saving to ME storage consumes its blank patterns.
eae2_pattern.editor.blank_recipe: Shapeless crafting: 1 blank pattern → 1 blank wildcard pattern.
eae2_pattern.editor.extract_choose: Select a recipe in Preview before using its forms.
eae2_pattern.editor.extract_none: No forms found. Click an ingredient to choose a tag.
eae2_pattern.editor.dynamic_help: Match this machine's recipes by rule, resolved on provider refresh. Unchecked recipes are excluded. Limit: 2048 per pattern; narrow the rule if exceeded.
eae2_pattern.editor.fixed_help: Save the checked recipes; encode again to include new ones. Supports the full search syntax. Form filters ignore reusable inputs.
eae2_pattern.editor.dynamic_query_help: Dynamic rules support $tags, &item IDs and @mod IDs. Use fixed collection for names, pinyin or tooltip text, and for unsupported machine types.
eae2_pattern.editor.dynamic_count: Dynamic rules · %s matches at last encoding
eae2_pattern.editor.rule_budget: Encode from machine recipes and filter rules.
eae2_pattern.editor.extract_applied: Forms applied. Include filters replaced; exclusions kept.
eae2_pattern.editor.reset_help: Craft a wildcard pattern on its own in a crafting grid or ME crafting terminal to clear all its data and recover a blank wildcard pattern.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_saved_inventory: One pattern encoded into your inventory. Remaining blanks stay in hand.
eae2_pattern.editor.pinyin_help: With Just Enough Characters, name and option searches accept pinyin or initials, such as tieding or td. For dynamic rules, search for a form or material, then select it.
eae2_pattern.wildcard.dynamic_note: Dynamic rules · count at last encoding

eae2_pattern.error.no_output: No encodable outputs. Adjust output settings.
eae2_pattern.error.network: The ME connection is unavailable or changed. Reconnect and retry.
eae2_pattern.error.held_changed: The held pattern changed. Reopen its editor.
eae2_pattern.error.busy: Another task is running. Try again shortly.
eae2_pattern.error.capacity: Capacity exceeded. Narrow the filters or use fixed collection.
eae2_pattern.error.fixed_mode: Use fixed collection for this machine.
eae2_pattern.error.no_match: No recipes match these rules. Adjust the filters.
eae2_pattern.error.missing_recipe: The recipe is unavailable. Reload this category.
eae2_pattern.error.failed: Encoding failed. Check the source recipe or logs.
